title: [SEP-9] Shared channels expose a CO–CO link and leave the countersignature undefined
description: Review finding SEP-9: Shared channels expose a CO–CO link and leave the countersignature undefined (lens SEP). Location: spec/08-cross-space.md:98; spec/05-messaging.md:204. Fix: As proposed. A relay holding both agreements sees one first-epoch key and token registered under two billing DIDs, which falsifies "they do not learn ... that the channel is shared". A single `billingSig` cannot satisfy relays registered under the other agreement. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
